reviews.text: Surfing on the blood of your fallen enemies is such a power move.

8.5/10 PROS: - Morally grey characters = GREAT STORYTELLING - Lots of replayability - Art is insanely good - Comedy is PEAK CONS: -Needs some balancing on skills and difficulty -Needs some extra debugging -You can tell this is an indie game trying to be AAA The best part of this game is the story. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ IS GOOD. The comedy moments are great, even though the animation during cutscenes is as simple as it gets, the dialogue is great. The NPCs also add a lot to the overall fun, and they offer so many useful things for your runs. You can see the Hades influence in this game. What I love the most is definitely the whole "get ready" moments you get before heading out. You buy your upgrades, go for a drink or a cup of tea, put on your best jewelry, and then go out to the streets to literally surf on the blood of your enemies. The way that this game handles gore, crime, violence, and torture is so good that you find yourself rooting for the villains. However, as a roguelite, one of the most important elements is GOOD BALANCE in difficulty, currency, upgrades, etc. This game has like 20 different currencies, it takes ages to upgrade characters, and even though you can adjust the dififculty, it still feels very unpolished, Hopefully during the Early Access they can find the real balance as well as fix all the bugs, because damn it this game has a loooootta bugs. Overall: Story: 100000/10 Characters: 8/10 Gameplay: 8/10 Music: 5/10 Art: 10/10

这是一款肉鸽动作游戏。 游戏的画面还是很不错的，角色建模是Q版小人，看着比较可爱，不过立绘却是美漫风格，略微狂野，感觉就有点不太匹配Q版小人，如果用日萌系的立绘可能会更好点。 游戏的背景是架空历史，故事发生在第一次世界大战之后，一个恐怖组织发动了炸弹袭击之后被抓进了一个监狱，然后女主不知道怎么回事也被关了进去，于是一行人就开始计划逃狱。 玩法上就是肉鸽动作了。 玩家需要在一个由六边形网格组成的地图块上选择需要移动的地块，进入地块之后则会遇到事件，虽然也有商店和一些特殊事件，不过大体上还是以战斗为主。 玩家初始就可以选择两个角色，战斗过程中可以随意切换，如果一个角色死亡则会切换成另一个，未被控制的另一个则是无敌的，也会稍微帮忙攻击一下敌人。 而进入战斗之后就是俯视角动作的玩法了，敌人会不停刷新，玩家打败敌人之后就能获得奖励，可以获得各种主动或者被动技能。 获得的技能也是能给任意一个角色添加的。 操作手感还行，闪避能躲开大部分攻击，不过普通后摇较长，会延误闪避的时间。 比较有特色的是，怪物死亡之后玩家可以继续攻击怪物的尸体，之后怪物的尸体会爆出一地的血液，一些特殊的攻击方式是需要用到的，这点还是挺有意思的。 初始的难度较高，一个角色大几百的血，被小怪打一下三四百就没了，也就是说别看游戏初期玩家有两个角色，但是实际上那薄弱的性能连弱鸡都算不上，基本上就是鸡饲料的水准。 不过可以通过局外加强来升级角色强度，升级之后就会觉得游戏难度会慢慢下降，直到连boss都可以吊打--当然，这还是需要花一定时间的。 无中文，剧情什么的到无所谓，但是选技能的时候就有点麻烦。 总结 比较有意思的小品级动作肉鸽游戏，可解锁内容和机制还是有点意思的，就没有中文这点比较可惜。 [quote]游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见[/quote]

近日，一款颇为热门的JRPG《百英雄传》发行，它与它的前作并非是同家制作商，也并非同一个发行商，而前作叫做《百英雄传：崛起》，正是由本作的作者开发！ 《Penny Blood: Hellbound》是一款较为美式的漫画艺术风格的动作肉鸽。艺术风格美式，游戏节奏也较为美式，形象比较夸张但又是Q版建模，表情幅度较大，战斗也会比较激进，属于是动作比较爽的那类动作肉鸽。 同样的，它是一款经典的动作肉鸽，斩杀一切来犯的怪物、升级、获得技能。不过在此之前，它还是一个通过走格子的方式进行探索，只有到战斗的格子是才会进入到一个较大的地形中进行动作砍杀，限时防守，也有着那么一股塔防味吧。打击感爽，节奏快。但和一般肉鸽不同的是，它是双角色切换游玩，没有切到的那个“队友”会很佛系的帮助攻击，血量也是无敌的。（那可以卡丝血当全血玩？） 像肉鸽一样会获得3选1的技能，这个技能是分别分配到不同角色升上的，分别用QWE等键位来释放，然后也需要切到那个角色操作了，才能使用所搭配的技能。因此前期选角、这之后的技能展现以及操作都是在考验玩家。不过，较为不爽的是它的闪避功能，总是迟一步吃到了伤害，似乎是莫名的前摇时间长，攻击时候动作无法被打断叫停，以闪避优先。 至于其它，就如一般肉鸽游戏无异。需要玩家进行一定的角色积累才能更好的往更后面的内容方向推进。目前本作没有中文，仅有日、英的文本内容和日英两语的配音，不过游戏实际的文本内容不多，也不复杂，并不影响真正的游玩！ 虽然商店页面写着只能通过控制器游玩，但可以不听劝，或许初始测试时是有这样的要求，如今它的键鼠操作手感已经倍好了。键盘的移动和鼠标的攻击方向配合的天衣无缝！ [code]双语评测，认准我们： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35263058-Bilingual-Curator/]双语评测[/url] Make Chinese and English speaker feel at home： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35263058-Bilingual-Curator/]Bilingual Curator[/url][/code]

I truly hate doing this, but I don't recommend this game at all. The art is amazing, the music is on point, but the combat is horrible. It feels floaty, enemies ignore all your attacks so it feels like an arcady mobile game when it comes to the actual gameplay. The skills and mid-run upgrades are mostly useless but a few. The leveling up mechanics and premise are all badass - for me, its the combat that just ruins it all.

Fun little game, currently in open access with only 1 more update to go. Well worth checking out, but if you're hesitant I might suggest waiting till the full release later this year. It's basically a rogue-like with 4 player co-op, though I've only played it solo so far. Lots of progression systems and unlockables and plenty of things to work away at, so the rogue-like aspect doesn't make your time spent feel redundant. Also lots of hilarious "lore" unlocks. The game is this bizarre mixture of goofy humour and ludicrous violence. The whole thing is ridiculously insane, and you'll either find the paradoxial cutesy-gorey, wacky-serious nature of it all extremely off putting or very entertaining. [spoiler] If its not the latter you've no taste[/spoiler]

It's a fun roguelike that serves as a spin-off/prequel to the main Penny Blood game, the spiritual successor to the PS2 series Shadow Hearts. Hellbound is now out of early access, and this latest update seems to have fixed some of the bugs I previously encountered too (Edit: There are still a few bugs such as the game freezing on the white screen that fades out of a stage and back into the game world, and the bug where stage prizes do not spawn which causes the player to be trapped within the stage. I really hope these get addressed in a future patch). The gameplay is fun, the music is great, the enemy designs are visually cool, and the writing is interesting. Now if a publisher out there could PLEASE agree to fund and publish the main game, that would be greatly appreciated.

TLDR: 6.5/10 (7.0 if you like charming games with some jank), get on sale for $10. An action roguelite that has a ton of content...that I will never see because even after sinking 44 hours into the game and fully completing it, a lot of the upgrades are stuck behind very grindy elements that rely on certain items dropping multiple times (which is already rare) for a single upgrade. The game itself feels like Hades through the lens of Penny Blood, a game I backed on KS that is eventually supposed to resemble a Shadow Hearts-esque JRPG. Penny Blood: Hellbound represents the first foray into this world and to help attract more interest to help fund a more expanded future title. With that in mind, I would recommend this game once it hits about $10, as there are a couple major elements that need improved before I could recommend it at full price. The game economy is way too stingy and I completed the game without ever fully leveling a single character, even though there is a quest associated with the MC Clara. A lot of the room configurations repeat too quickly, leading to the game feeling like there is not a lot of content within. I also had to lose 4 - 5 runs when the exit portal didn't spawn upon clearing a room. If these issues are addressed, Penny Blood: Hellbound could be a Hades-like experience, but the reward unlocks have to be realigned with the idea of fully unlocking everything after 40 hours or so, as there is just not enough content right now to justify playing it beyond that.

While the game has great art and a lot of unlocks, combat however is unforgivably clunky with immense hitlag after attacks and no dodge-cancelling of animations, all while enemies can jump you from off-screen. Despite a lot of good ideas and effort that clearly went into the game, it just doesn't make up for combat being irritating and frustrating. Also multiplayer is dead (0 players online).

Game is incredibly difficult for bad reasons, enemies never stagger so melee is suicide. Camera doesn't stay zoomed out far enough so enemies can charge from off the corners of the screen and hit you when you can't even see them, enemies also have auto tracking on their attacks so you can skate around behind an enemy and still get hit regardless. There's a weird delay between attacking and dodging so you can't reliably dodge, either. The game is also not coop like it claims, the multiplayer is just a wave survival mode.

Maybe this game gets better towards the end of the game, but the early game combat is really unsatisfying. As others have mentioned, the art is incredible! The music is great! But it's just not fun to play. If you're looking for a roguelite/ roguelike there are much better games out there.
